recent_reviews.content: The privacy check feature that audits app permissions is useful but limited on iOS. Most of the heavy lifting is done by Apple's built-in privacy controls. McAfee just surfaces what's already there.
recent_reviews.author: PrivacyCheck_iOS

recent_reviews.content: Installation was a nightmare. Failed three times with error code 12152. Had to completely uninstall using their removal tool, reboot, then try again. Tech support kept me on hold for 45 minutes before helping.
recent_reviews.author: AngryCustomer2026

recent_reviews.content: Cannot believe the price went up to $49.99 for Mac-only protection. That is outrageous when Avast and AVG offer free alternatives that score just as well in AV-TEST benchmarks. Not worth it at all.
recent_reviews.author: PriceWatcher2026

recent_reviews.content: The auto-renewal trapped me into another year. The cancellation process is intentionally complicated — hidden deep in account settings and requires calling support. Dark pattern UI design.
recent_reviews.author: DarkPattern_Victim

recent_reviews.content: Does the basic job of scanning for malware on Mac. Performance impact is minimal on my M1 MacBook Air. Nothing special but nothing terrible. A safe, middle-of-the-road choice.
recent_reviews.author: M1_MiddleRoad

recent_reviews.content: Solid antivirus with good real-time protection. The VPN included in Total Protection works well for basic browsing. Only complaint is the occasional pop-up asking me to upgrade features I already have.
recent_reviews.author: HomeUser_Janet

recent_reviews.content: Good protection suite for Mac. The firewall configuration is straightforward and the VPN works reliably for my daily use. Wish it had a system cleaner feature like CleanMyMac offers.
recent_reviews.author: MacPowerUser

recent_reviews.content: Ads everywhere! Even after paying for premium, I still get pop-ups promoting other McAfee products. This is unacceptable for a paid antivirus. Feels like adware.
recent_reviews.author: NoMoreAds_Please

recent_reviews.content: McAfee saved me from a banking trojan! The real-time scanner detected a malicious overlay app targeting my banking credentials. Blocked it instantly and notified me. This is why you need good antivirus.
recent_reviews.author: BankingSafe_User

recent_reviews.content: Excellent protection for my small business PCs. McAfee caught a ransomware attempt that our previous solution missed completely. The centralized management console makes it easy to manage 15 workstations.
recent_reviews.author: SmallBizIT

recent_reviews.content: The battery drain is unacceptable. My MacBook Air M2 loses about 15% more battery per day with McAfee running. For a laptop that is supposed to last all day, this is a deal breaker. Switching to Malwarebytes.
recent_reviews.author: BatteryLife_Matters

recent_reviews.content: Average antivirus. Does the job of detecting malware but nothing exceptional. The firewall works fine. Wish the scan scheduling was more flexible — can only set daily or weekly, no custom schedules.
recent_reviews.author: CasualUser_Tom

recent_reviews.content: As a graphic designer who downloads assets from various sources, McAfee gives me peace of mind. It caught a trojan embedded in a font file from an unverified source. Scan speed on my M3 Max is blazing fast.
recent_reviews.author: DesignPro_Maya

recent_reviews.content: Good protection app overall. The app lock feature is useful for privacy. Wi-Fi scanner works well. Would give 5 stars if the UI was more modern looking.
recent_reviews.author: PixelUser_2026

recent_reviews.content: The scan speed is painfully slow. A full system scan takes over 4 hours on my SSD-based system. Competitors finish in under an hour. Also, the UI feels dated compared to Kaspersky and Bitdefender.
recent_reviews.author: TechReviewer_Dan

recent_reviews.content: It works but feels unnecessary on a Mac. macOS already has decent built-in protection with Gatekeeper and XProtect. McAfee adds some extra scanning but at the cost of noticeable battery drain on my MacBook Pro.
recent_reviews.author: MacSkeptic

recent_reviews.content: McAfee completely destroyed my PC performance. Boot time went from 30 seconds to over 3 minutes. Every program takes forever to open. This is supposed to protect my computer, not make it unusable. Demanding a full refund.
recent_reviews.author: SlowPC_Mike

recent_reviews.content: McAfee on macOS Sequoia is a disaster. Constant kernel panics and system freezes. Had to boot into safe mode to uninstall it. Apple Silicon optimization is clearly an afterthought for this product.
recent_reviews.author: MacDevFrustrated

recent_reviews.content: Battery drain is insane since last update. My phone goes from 100% to 20% by noon with McAfee running in background. Had to force stop it to save battery. Fix this ASAP!
recent_reviews.author: BatteryDead_User

alerts.message: Mac desktop average rating dropped from 3.8 to 3.45 over the past two weeks. Installation and performance issues are primary drivers.

alerts.title: Customer Support Complaints Rising
alerts.message: Customer support related negative reviews increased 25%. Common complaints: long wait times, scripted responses, billing issues.

alerts.title: Installation Failures on Windows Desktop
alerts.message: Multiple reports of BSOD and system crashes during McAfee installation on Windows 11 systems. Version 16.8.2 may have compatibility issues.
